title: job.cancel (v1)
description: Command to the worker running a job. Published by job-orchestrator to `lean.control` with routing key `job.<jobId>.cancel.v1`, AMQP type `control.v1.CancelJob`, persistent. The worker binds one exclusive queue per running job. A worker that holds a different `leaseEpoch` than the one named ignores it for live jobs only if its epoch is newer.

attempt.description: Attempt to stop; absent = whatever attempt is running.

leaseEpoch.description: Live only: the epoch being revoked. Workers holding this or an older epoch stop their engine process.
